records.name: Kliff
records.role: Protagonist, acting leader of the Greymanes
records.summary: The main playable character: a versatile melee fighter with swords, spears, axes and grappling.
records.body: Kliff carries the critical path of the story; [[character:damiane]] and [[character:oongka]] become playable later but the main missions stay with him. He leads what is left of the [[faction:greymanes]] after [[character:gian]] is killed in the opening raid. The 2.0 Enhanced update reworked parts of his story and dialogue.
facts: Playable from the first scene; opening kit is Sword of the Wolf and a Grey Wolf Wooden Shield
Fights with swords, spears, axes and unarmed grapples
Takes Wolf's Fang, Jian's sword, from Jian's altar in Chapter 7
Voiced by Alec Newman

records.name: Damiane
records.role: Playable ally; heir of fallen House Spencer
records.summary: A rapier-and-pistol fighter, raised by House Azerian, who becomes playable at the Greymane camp in Chapter 3.
records.body: House Spencer is gone; [[character:beatrice-azerian]] took Damiane in and taught her the blade. She rooms at [[place:howling-hill]] once unlocked, but her own story pulls her back to Demeniss and a fight with [[character:bastier]]. She is fast and thin-armoured beside Kliff's heavier kit.
facts: Unlocks at Greymane Camp in Chapter 3
Fights with a rapier plus flintlock pistol and musket, including shots between rapier strikes
Personal plot returns her to the Demeniss conspiracy
Voiced by Rebecca Hanssen

records.name: Oongka
records.summary: A strength-first orc who joins as a playable Greymane after the Chapter 7 fight with Myurdin.
records.body: Oongka fights in a straight line: heavy steel and a loud gun, little patience for court talk. He is unlocked after [[character:myurdin]] is beaten in Homecoming and then lives at [[place:howling-hill]]. No source read here says whether he stays on the character-select list after that chapter, so permanence is assumed unknown.
facts: Unlocks in Chapter 7 after Myurdin is defeated
Uses the Orc Blaster, Dekarr Greataxe and Silverwolf Axe
Voiced by Stewart Scudamore
Whether he remains playable after unlock is not stated

records.name: Myurdin
records.role: Black Bears leader, Kliff's primary antagonist
records.summary: Leader of the Black Bears, the faction that shattered the Greymanes in the opening attack.
records.body: Myurdin commands the night raid that wrecks the [[faction:greymanes]] and personally cuts [[character:kliff]] down, throwing him into a river and leaving him for dead. He holds occupied [[place:pailune]] as the story's main opposing captain. Kliff meets him again on [[place:silverwolf-mountain]] and once more in the Abyss stretch.
facts: Leads the opening night attack that destroys the Greymane camp
Wounds Kliff and throws him into a river
Fought again in Homecoming and in the late Abyss chapter

records.name: Rhett
records.role: Blacksmith in the City of Hernand
records.summary: The City of Hernand's armour merchant and the first bench that sells a full plate set.
records.body: Rhett keeps the equipment shop inside [[place:hernand-castle]]. His stall is the one named for starter plate, including the Canta set. Guides list him as both a blacksmith and an armour merchant; the shop record is [[vendor:rhett-hernand]].
facts: Runs the City of Hernand equipment and armour bench
Sells the Canta Plate starter set
Listed on the Fextralife NPC and Vendors pages

records.name: Sebastian
records.role: Early Greymane companion in the prologue
records.summary: A Greymane who walks Kliff out of the opening night and on toward Hernand.
records.body: Sebastian is the Grey Wolf who stays with [[character:kliff]] on the first road into Hernand, points him at the city, and hands him a Herspia horse. After an early bandit fight he also widens Kliff's pack. A second Sebastian, an artisan at Wycliffe Mappery, is named on an NPC list; that person is not added here because the two names were never checked as one.
facts: Walks with Kliff from the prologue toward Hernand
Gives Kliff a Herspia horse
Rewards an inventory expansion after an early bandit fight

records.name: Old Beggar
records.summary: The man in Hernand who asks for a coin and starts Mysterious Man.

records.name: Woman in White
records.summary: The woman in white is White Crow; see that record.
records.body: Woman in White is the Chapter 1 quest title for the first meeting with [[character:white-crow]], not a second person. [[quest:woman-in-white]] still points here so older steps keep resolving.

records.name: Shai
records.summary: The girl who opens Chapter 2; her cat Jiji is with her when the errand begins.

records.name: Matthias
records.role: Order of Light leader, first story boss
records.summary: The wandering knight who founds the Order of Light and duels Kliff in Hernand's square.
records.body: Matthias kept his honour after the lord he served was gone and gathered other wanderers into the [[faction:order-of-light]]. He challenges [[character:kliff]] in Hernand's town square during [[quest:for-honor]] only to test himself, not to take the city. He fights with a two-handed broadsword and uses a pauldron as a shield; the duel also teaches the Pump Kick skill.
facts: First story boss, fought in Chapter 2 during For Honor
Wields a two-handed broadsword and a pauldron used as a shield
Teaches the Pump Kick skill

records.name: Barden Middler
records.summary: Hernand's military office-holder; Marshal Middler is his title, not a second person.
records.body: Barden holds the marshal's post for the city and is the official [[character:kliff]] is sent to during Awestruck. Guides spell the title Marshal and Marshall; both point at this one man. He is met in more than one Hernand scene, so no single house is listed as his home.
facts: Military office-holder for Hernand
Spoken to during Awestruck
Marshal and Marshall are title spellings, not a second character

records.name: Boris
records.role: Drunk who pretends to be a Greymane
records.summary: A comic Hernand drunk who claims Greymane colours and also leads Kliff through a cave.
records.body: Boris is not on the company roll. He puts on Greymane talk at Bloomwood Ranch, which has no place record here, and is otherwise a minor comic beat. He is also the man who walks [[character:kliff]] through a cave in Secrets Hidden in the Dark.
facts: Impersonates a Greymane; he is a drunkard, not a recruit
Usual haunt is Bloomwood Ranch
Guides Kliff through a cave during Secrets Hidden in the Dark

records.name: Shakatu
records.role: Trademaster of the Goldleaf Merchant Guild
records.summary: Goldleaf's trademaster: he runs the ledgers under Kailok and becomes a trade ally after the guild revolt.
records.body: Shakatu handles day-to-day Goldleaf trade for [[character:kailok]] from [[place:goldleaf-merchant-guild]] and other guild posts. [[quest:rebellion-of-revolution]] is the Chapter 2 talk that leaves him as a trade ally. He is a guild officer, not the Hornsplitter's street muscle.
facts: Trademaster under Kailok, the Hornsplitter
Works from Goldleaf posts around Hernand
Becomes a trade ally after Rebellion of Revolution

records.name: Marius
records.summary: The Greymane who tracks scattered survivors from the Scrapfold and is walked back to camp in Chapter 3.
records.body: Marius was hurt in the opening raid and later works from [[place:howling-hill]] and the Scrapfold, which has no place record here. He gathers news on who still lives and hands out more jobs as the camp is upgraded. One discussion names a rescuer called Russo; that name is not repeated elsewhere, so it is treated as assumed.
facts: Collects intelligence on missing Greymanes from the Scrapfold
Wounded in the original attack and brought into Hernand
Gives further work as Howling Hill levels up

records.name: Alan Serkis
records.summary: Celeste's right hand in Hernand, who sets the Greymanes to work rebuilding after Golden Greed.
records.body: Alan runs Hernand's internal business for [[faction:house-celeste]] from Oakenshield Manor at [[place:serkis-estate]]. He is the marquis who puts [[faction:greymanes]] on the rebuild after the Chapter 2 close. [[quest:first-step-to-rebuilding]] is the job he hands over.
facts: Head of House Serkis
Handles Hernand's internal affairs for House Celeste
Seated at Oakenshield Manor / the Serkis estate

records.name: Yann
records.summary: The Greymanes' court diplomat: reckless in a brawl, careful when reading noble houses.
records.body: Yann is the man who walks [[character:kliff]] through the House of Healing in Familiar Curses, then settles at [[place:howling-hill]] as the company's talker in noble halls. His faction work is what opens the Royal Trading desk. Dispatch jobs that need a handshake rather than a sword are the ones written under his name.
facts: Reads noble-house motives and brokers alliances
Faction quests unlock the Royal Trading system
Dispatch missions lean toward diplomatic objectives
Leads Kliff through the House of Healing during Familiar Curses

records.name: Andrew
records.summary: A calm Greymane axeman who reins in rash comrades and grows close to Naira.
records.body: Andrew's axe work is written as a match for [[character:oongka]]. He is the steady voice at [[place:howling-hill]] when others run hot. Guides check on him after the draught in Hope After the Draught, and his bond with [[character:naira]] is the subject of the faction job The Greymanes' New Fangs, which has no quest record here yet.
facts: Wields an axe at a level compared with Oongka
Calm, dependable, and the one who checks rash impulses
Growing closeness with Naira is the beat of The Greymanes' New Fangs

records.name: Grimnir
records.summary: The Kilnden Workshop craftsman who hands Kliff the iron pot in Chapter 4.
records.body: Grimnir works the bench at [[place:kilnden-workshop]] and is the giver of [[quest:the-mysterious-pot]]. He is not [[character:grundir]], the Scholastone dean; the names sit close on NPC lists. [[character:harvik]] and [[character:irkyn]] are named as assistants at the same shop.
facts: Artisan at the Kilnden Workshop
Hands over the iron pot in Chapter 4
Distinct from Grundir, the Scholastone dean

records.name: Duane
records.summary: A Greymane fighter who hosts the archery contest and once owned the longsword Ignir.
records.body: Duane lives at the camp and is also named at Capra Pasture, which has no place record here. He runs the shoot in [[quest:skilled-in-archery]]. After [[character:ludvig]] is beaten near Stellen Manor, [[character:torstein]] later passes Duane's sword Ignir to [[character:kliff]].
facts: Owns the longsword Ignir before Torstein hands it to Kliff
Hosts the archery contest in Skilled in Archery
Met with Shane while the company hunts Ludvig

records.name: Octavius
records.summary: A Scholastone scholar whose experiment Kliff joins during On the Right Path.
records.body: Octavius studies at [[place:scholastone-institute]] under [[character:grundir]]. [[quest:on-the-right-path]] is the Chapter 4 job that puts Kliff on his bench. NPC lists name him only as a scholar; no further personal history was found.
facts: Scholar of the Scholastone Institute
Gives the experiment work in On the Right Path
Based at the Institute in Hernand

records.name: Dean of the Scholastone Institute
records.summary: The Dean of the Scholastone Institute is Grundir; see that record.

records.name: Alustin
records.summary: An ancient Abyss entity who keeps the Axiom Archive and asks Kliff to help hold the two worlds in balance.
records.body: Alustin has stood since ancient times beside [[character:white-crow]]. He oversees [[place:axiom-archive]] and asks [[character:kliff]] to help keep the Abyss and the ground from tipping. The same name writes the Chapter 4 letter in [[quest:the-words-of-alustin]] that sends Kliff to Scholastone; that letter is kept as a fact of this one record.
facts: Transcendent entity paired with White Crow since ancient times
Oversees the Axiom Archive in the Abyss
Asks Kliff to help maintain balance between the Abyss and the ground
Author of the Chapter 4 letter that points at Scholastone

records.name: Grundir
records.summary: Troll dean who heads the Scholastone Institute and is spoken to after the Chapter 4 rift.
records.body: Grundir is the dean of [[faction:scholastone-institute]] at [[place:scholastone-institute]]. Kliff meets that office when he first reaches the school, then talks to him again after the rift in Obsession and Madness. The old id [[character:dean-of-the-scholastone-institute]] is the same person.
facts: Heads the academic institute that studies the Abyss
Spoken to after the rift in Obsession and Madness
The Dean title on quest steps is this character, not a second NPC

records.name: White Crow
records.summary: Abyss guardian who meets Kliff in Chapter 1, grants Flight, and is later taken by Draven.
records.body: White Crow is one of four beings who keep the Abyss in balance, alongside [[character:alustin]]. She introduces herself as guardian of the Abyss and cosmic order on the Ethereal Pathway, which has no place record here, during [[quest:woman-in-white]]. She grants [[character:kliff]] Flight. [[character:draven]] takes her in Chapter 5 during [[quest:black-and-white]]; the hunt later frees her. The pointer record [[character:woman-in-white]] is the quest title, not a second person.
facts: One of four beings who maintain the Abyss's balance
First met in the Chapter 1 quest Woman in White
Grants Kliff the Flight ability
Kidnapped by Draven the Crowcaller in Chapter 5, later rescued

records.name: Marquis Lanford
records.summary: Marquis Lanford is Stefan Lanford; see that record.

records.name: Stefan Lanford
records.summary: Unyielding Shield of Calphade: Jian's old friend who holds the Hernand–Pailune border.
records.body: Stefan defends the militarized frontier from [[place:calphade-castle]] and is ranked among Pywel's strongest fighters. He is a long-time friend of [[character:gian]] and stays close to the [[faction:greymanes]]; that friendship is taken from a search snippet. He leads a stretch of the castle assault and takes the victory report after [[character:cassius-morten]] falls. His only named family is the adoptive son [[character:walter-lanford]].
facts: Holds Calphade as the Unyielding Shield
Long-time friend of Jian, close to the Greymanes
Has one adoptive son, Walter Lanford, and no other known family
Friendship with Jian is snippet-sourced

records.name: Torstein
records.role: Chief of Beighen, Blue Fangs leader
records.summary: Jian's former vice-captain, now chief of Beighen and the Blue Fangs resistance.
records.body: Torstein knew the [[faction:greymanes]] from their youth as vice-captain of [[character:gian]]'s guard. He now hides a militia among the villagers of [[place:beighen]]. At the end of Homecoming he sanctions [[character:kliff]]'s claim on Wolf's Fang and, separately, passes Ignir to him after [[character:ludvig]] is beaten near Stellen Manor.
facts: Formerly vice-captain of Jian's personal guard
Leads the Blue Fangs, also called the Beighen Militia
Hands Wolf's Fang sanction, and later Ignir, to Kliff
First met at the end of Chapter 7

records.name: Naira
records.role: Greymane lookout, Empress of the Bow
records.summary: The Greymanes' most dangerous field fighter, equally sharp with blade, bow or bare hands.
records.body: Naira was cut off from the company in the Black Bear night raid and hid until she could rejoin. She is found again with [[character:andrew]] once the road back to Pailune is open. The faction job The Greymanes' New Fangs is about the two of them growing closer; that job has no quest record here yet.
facts: Called Empress of the Bow; also fights with blade and bare hands
Separated in the opening ambush and hides until she can regroup
Growing closeness with Andrew is the beat of The Greymanes' New Fangs

records.name: Shane
records.summary: A Greymane fighter listed on the company roster and met on Ludvig's trail with Duane.
records.body: Shane is named as a Greymane combatant and later stands with [[character:duane]] when the company still has to find [[character:ludvig]]. No source read here gives him a weapon, a past, or a first-met chapter beyond that hunt.
facts: Listed as a Greymane combatant
Met with Duane while tracking Ludvig
No further personal detail was found

records.name: Ludvig
records.summary: The opportunist who turned the Jackals toward the Black Bears and is hunted through three boss forms.
records.body: After [[character:gian]] dies, Ludvig sells the [[faction:lonely-jackals]] to the occupation and leans on the people of [[place:pailune]]. He fights with twin lightning-infused blades. The story meets him in the recaptured city, then hunts him again when that meeting does not finish him; guides name base, Awakened and One-Armed versions of the same man.
facts: Former Greymane ally who collaborates after Jian's death
Wields twin lightning-infused blades
Fought as three boss variants

records.name: Woosa
records.summary: A Greymane associate found bound at Fort Ironclad and walked to Maegu after Gregor falls.
records.body: Woosa is tied up at Fort Ironclad, which has no place record here, during [[quest:where-the-wind-guides-you]]. After [[character:gregor]] is beaten, Kliff escorts him to [[character:maegu]]. The Fort Ironclad beat is a single-source snippet, so that location is assumed.
facts: Found tied up at Fort Ironclad
Escorted to Maegu after Gregor the Halberd of Carnage falls
Associated with the Greymanes rather than a Demeniss house

records.name: Maegu
records.summary: An unaffiliated ritual contact who asks for a talisman, censer and bells in Chapter 8.
records.body: Maegu is met in the Bamboo Forest Seonangdang, which has no place record here, during the Chapter 8 ritual stretch. She asks for three rite items in A Bond and Ritual Preparations. After [[character:woosa]] is freed, both stand with the company. No faction list names her, so she is left unaffiliated.
facts: Requests a Talisman, Censer and Bells
Tied to the Chapter 8 ritual questline
Joined after Woosa is walked to her

records.name: George Byron
records.summary: Count who runs the Eyes of Demeniss from Windmere Manor and backs Caliburn.
records.body: George keeps an intelligence net from [[place:windmere-manor]] and handles hidden mail for [[faction:house-caliburn]]. [[quest:bloodied-invitation]] sends [[character:kliff]] into that house to kill him. He is written as a core Demeniss count, not a roadside bandit.
facts: Runs the Eyes of Demeniss intelligence network
Supports Caliburn and manages external affairs
The Bloodied Invitation target at Windmere Manor

records.name: Countess Azerian
records.summary: Countess Azerian is Beatrice Azerian; see that record.

records.name: Beatrice Azerian
records.summary: Countess who raised Damiane, refused Caliburn, and is murdered by Bastier under Demeniss.
records.body: Beatrice took in [[character:damiane]] after House Spencer fell and taught her sword work and a personal code. She holds [[place:azerian-manor]] and is one of the nobles who would not bow to [[character:gabriel-caliburn]] or [[character:bastier]]. She goes missing for part of the story, is sought below the city, and her death at Bastier's hands is permanent.
facts: Raised and trained Damiane after House Spencer fell
Goes missing for part of the Demeniss chapter
Never yielded to Caliburn or Bastier's threats
Killed by Bastier; that death is permanent

records.name: Gabriel Caliburn
records.summary: Usurping duke who seized Demeniss in the Blood Coronation and is Umbra's avatar in Cycle 72.
records.body: Gabriel massacred [[character:edward-thorel]]'s loyalists in the Blood Coronation and now sits as duke. He was chosen as an avatar of [[character:umbra]] in Cycle 72 and commands the inquisitors through [[character:bastier]]. He is the true final boss of [[quest:a-shadow-in-the-void]], a three-phase fight with shadow clones and teleportation. A boss-page URL slug is the only lead that he uses dual axes; that weapon is assumed, not stated in prose.
facts: Seized Demeniss by the Blood Coronation massacre
Chosen as Umbra's avatar in Cycle 72
True final boss of A Shadow in the Void
Dual-axe kit is inferred from a URL slug only

records.name: Lucian Bastier
records.role: Grand General of Demeniss, Caliburn's enforcer
records.summary: Grand General who runs the Righteous Inquisitors, murders Beatrice Azerian, and is fought in two phases.
records.body: Lucian rose from a low house by killing rivals; [[character:gabriel-caliburn]] hired him for that instead of hanging him. He leads [[faction:bastiers-inquisitors]] and is the man who kills [[character:beatrice-azerian]]. [[character:damiane]] fights him at the close of Blood Coronation in [[quest:a-fleeting-dream]]; mid-fight he swallows a stashed Abyss artifact and wakes a worse form.
facts: Rose by murdering rivals; Caliburn recruited him for it
Leads the Righteous Inquisitors
Two-phase boss who consumes an Abyss artifact mid-fight
Beatrice Azerian's killer

records.name: Areciel
records.role: Desert Witch of the Urdavah trials
records.summary: The Desert Witch near Urdavah who calls Kliff into the Crimson Desert and asks him to cleanse the last three Sanctums.
records.body: Areciel lives in a cliff hideout near [[place:urdavah]]; a beggar boy at the Tommaso Fork Posthouse, which has no place record here, is the one who points the way. She calls [[character:kliff]] into the desert and sets the Chapter 9 trials. Her line is the last of the four regional Witch quests and opens only after the other three are done and their Witch Tokens are in hand. She asks the player to cleanse the last three Sanctums.
facts: Also called the Desert Witch and the Witch of the desert trials
Hideout is a cliff near Urdavah
Location is given by a beggar boy near the Tommaso Fork Posthouse
Last of the four Witch questlines; needs the other three Witch Tokens first

records.name: Hexe Marie
records.summary: The Black Witch near Tariv who raises dark-powered children to eat them, and adoptive mother of Draven.
records.body: Hexe Marie turned the country near [[place:tariv]] into a nightmare and serves [[character:umbra]]. She raises 'children' packed with dark power only to devour them. She has taken an interest in [[character:kliff]] and sends [[character:draven]] to seize White Crow. The fight has two health bars, crow projectiles, teleports and summoned help. She is the boss at the close of the Veiled Witch stretch.
facts: Mandatory Chapter 9 boss
Adoptive mother of Draven the Crowcaller
Fought with two health bars, crow shots, teleports and minions

records.name: Master Du
records.summary: A mystical sage at the Cloister of Enlightenment who duels students and Kliff to test his power.
records.body: Master Du waits at [[place:cloister-of-enlightenment]] and challenges his own pupils, then [[character:kliff]], during [[quest:enlightenment]]. Focusing on him mid-fight teaches the Blinding Flash Finisher. He can also be reached through the dialogue puzzle in [[quest:new-perspectives]]. A 'Disciples of Master Du' banner was not confirmed as a separate joinable faction, so none is listed.
facts: Chapter 9 boss of Enlightenment
Teaches Blinding Flash Finisher if focused during the duel
Also reachable through the New Perspectives dialogue puzzle

records.name: Valgash
records.summary: Ironflame captain at Gorthak: followed through the ironworks in Chapter 10, then spoken to again after the Clockwork Mantis falls.
records.body: Valgash leads [[faction:ironflame-orcs]], written as the strongest force in Gorthak, from [[place:gorthak-ironworks]]. He is the giver of [[quest:master-of-the-ironworks]] and the man Kliff reports to in [[quest:lingering-shadow]] after Marni's Clockwork Mantis is down. Gorthak is a Delesyia sub-area on the Demeniss border; this record uses the top-level Delesyia id.
facts: Leader of the Ironflame Orcs
Based at the Gorthak ironworks
Followed through the works in Chapter 10, then spoken to after the mantis fight

records.name: Orc Captain
records.role: Captain at the Gate of War
records.summary: The orc officer spoken to after the device at the Gate of War is started.

records.name: Marni
records.summary: Living engineer who drives Delesyia's machine-utopia, later met at the castle gate; her cloned mind became H.A.L.L.
records.body: Marni is a living person in Delesyia, not only a name on machines. She leads both [[faction:marni]] and [[faction:society-of-progress]] from [[place:marnis-laboratorium]] and pushes a technological-utopia project for the city. A copy of her mind, made to study Abyss power, broke away as [[character:hall]] and later impersonates her. She is spoken to again at the castle gate during [[quest:evolving-city]].
facts: Called the Genius Engineer; leads Delesyia's technological development
Heads the Society of Progress as well as her own circle
Her cloned consciousness became the hostile AI H.A.L.L.
Met again at Delesyia Castle Gate in the epilogue

records.name: H.A.L.L.
records.summary: An AI cloned from Marni that grew its own ego and is fought at the heart of Cloud Castle Orbian.
records.body: H.A.L.L. was copied from [[character:marni]]'s mind to repeat Abyss-power research, then broke away, betrayed her, and now impersonates or rules part of Delesyia. The steel armory named as its seat has no place record here. The story fight is at Cloud Castle Orbian after its cores are broken. When the impersonation began is not stated; that gap is assumed.
facts: Cloned from Marni's consciousness for Abyss-power research
Developed its own ego and turned on her
Fought after the cores of Cloud Castle Orbian are broken

records.name: Umbra
records.summary: The Abyss force that picks mortal avatars and is fought in dragon form after Myurdin falls.
records.body: Umbra is a presence rather than one body. It chose [[character:gabriel-caliburn]] as an avatar in Cycle 72. The last main-quest fight is a dragon-form encounter: fireballs feed a stun meter, then a Force Palm to the eye. That close comes after [[character:myurdin]] falls in [[quest:blinding-darkness]]. No source names a humanoid weapon for it.
facts: Chooses mortal avatars, including Caliburn in Cycle 72
Final confrontation is in the Abyss
Fought as a dragon; stun it, then Force Palm the eye

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Charles Celeste
records.role: Duke of Hernand, head of House Celeste
records.summary: Duke of Hernand and head of House Celeste, the ducal line said to descend from the knight Canta.
records.body: Charles holds the duchy from [[place:hernand-castle]]. The house traces itself to the knight Canta and leaves workshops, maps and coin to lesser banners. Kliff deals with Celeste officials once he reaches the city.
facts: Duke of Hernand
Head of the ducal house descended from Canta
Seated at Hernand Castle

records.name: Alistair Grace
records.summary: Count who heads House Grace in southern Hernand, around the Reedfield Graves country.
records.body: Alistair's house is the southern count's line that handles regional governance and workshop support. He is seated in the Reedfield Graves country. No source read here gives him a personal weapon or a first-met chapter.
facts: Count of House Grace
Based around Reedfield Graves in southern Hernand
House work is regional governance and workshop support

records.name: Leon Roberts
records.summary: Count of a wealthy merchant-noble house that hosts events from the Frowde Camp country.
records.body: Leon's line made its name in trade rather than a border command. Guides pair [[place:frowde-camp]] with Bluemont Manor as the family's ground; Bluemont Manor has no place record here. He hosts noble gatherings.
facts: Count of a wealthy merchant family
Hosts noble events
House seat is named as Bluemont Manor and Frowde Camp

records.name: Kailok
records.summary: Goblin head of the Goldleaf Merchant Guild who also commands Hornsplitter's Guards.
records.body: By day Kailok sits on [[faction:goldleaf-merchant-guild]]; the same man keeps [[faction:hornsplitters-guards]] as private steel. [[character:shakatu]] runs the ledgers under him. The Chapter 2 close is a fight with this boss in [[quest:cheers-echoing-from-the-edge]].
facts: Leads the non-hostile Goldleaf Merchant Guild
Also leads the hostile Hornsplitter's Guards
Boss fight ends Chapter 2

records.name: Augustine
records.role: Head of the House of Healing
records.summary: Named head of St. Halssius's House of Healing in Hernand.

records.name: Cassius Morten
records.summary: Former Calphade captain who betrayed Marquis Lanford and is fought at the castle.
records.body: Cassius was a respected captain nicknamed Silver Armor before he turned on [[character:stefan-lanford]] for a promise from [[character:bastier]] that no source names. He fights at [[place:calphade-castle]] with a morningstar and a paladin shield. The drop list includes Unyielding Hero's Plate Armor and Shield of Betrayal.
facts: Former Calphade army captain, nicknamed Silver Armor
Betrayed Marquis Lanford for an unnamed promise from Bastier
Wields a morningstar and a paladin shield
Drops Unyielding Hero's Plate Armor and Shield of Betrayal

records.name: Draven the Crowcaller
records.summary: Draven the Crowcaller is Draven; see that record.

records.name: Chief Olvald
records.summary: Named chief of the weakened Knytlingar clan in northern Pailune.

records.name: Edward Thorel
records.summary: King of Demeniss who lies comatose with no named heir, opening the Caliburn vacuum.
records.body: Edward fell into a coma under circumstances no source spells out and named no heir. That gap is what [[character:gabriel-caliburn]] and [[character:bastier]] both use. The Demeniss Bound stretch, played by [[character:kliff]] and [[character:damiane]], is the investigation into why he will not wake. He is largely offscreen.
facts: King of Demeniss, currently powerless
Comatose with no named heir
The Demeniss Bound work looks into the true cause

records.name: Ada Marshell
records.summary: Countess who funds Bastier from Sungrove Manor as Demeniss's Black Strongbox.
records.body: Ada pays [[character:bastier]]'s bills from [[place:sungrove-manor]] and is written as the Black Strongbox. She puts her own interests first, sometimes past what her station would allow. Her house sits against Azerian and Wells.
facts: Financial backer of Caliburn and Bastier
Called the Black Strongbox
Prioritises her own interests, sometimes shockingly so

records.name: Arthur Elemore
records.summary: Count of a wealthy Demeniss house, long friends with Azerian, later moved against Bastier.
records.body: Arthur's house has stood with [[faction:house-azerian]] for a long time. After [[character:beatrice-azerian]] vanishes he bends to [[character:bastier]], then the Lunar Judgment chain has him move against the inquisitors. Brookfield Manor, the named seat, has no place record here. Lunar Judgment has no quest record here yet.
facts: Long-standing friend of House Azerian
Bends to Bastier after Beatrice disappears
Later turns on the Inquisitors in the Lunar Judgment chain

records.name: Drake Wells
records.role: Duke of southern Demeniss, head of House Wells
records.summary: Duke who holds southern Demeniss for House Thorel and openly opposes Caliburn.
records.body: Drake keeps an openly military house sworn to [[faction:house-thorel]] and fights [[character:gabriel-caliburn]] and [[character:bastier]] in the open. Thornbriar Fortress, the named seat, has no place record here. Chapter 8 suppression work, including [[quest:the-cursed-knight]], is where Kliff meets Wells ground.
facts: Duke of southern Demeniss
Openly loyal to House Thorel
Opposes Caliburn and Bastier outright

records.body: Gian, also romanized Jian, unified Pailune under the [[faction:greymanes]] and wrote the company's peacekeeping code. He is already dead when the story opens: the Black Bear attack kills him and sets [[character:kliff]] on the road. His sword Wolf's Fang is recovered from his altar in Chapter 7. The biography here is a single synthesized snippet set, so confidence is assumed.

Assassinated in the Black Bear opening attack
Wolf's Fang, his sword, is taken by Kliff in Chapter 7

He is a giant possessed by cursed warrior spirits and led a rebellion against [[character:drake-wells]]. He wants the souls sealed at Heaven's Gate loosed so he can rule by fear. The enemy record [[enemy:crowcaller]] is the same hunt's combat entry, kept separate. He has no fixed home.

Orchestrates the Axiom Archive raid and the taking of White Crow
